details.label: Student story · Shortlisted Program
details.heading: From Aspiration to Achievement:
details.description: When Suvam S. Mishra began his job search, he was looking for more than just an opportunity—he wanted a platform that could help him showcase his skills, prepare for industry expectations, and connect with the right employers.
details.heroImageAlt: Suvam S. Mishra - AI Engineer at Authority Entrepreneurs

columns.title: The Journey & Aspirations
paragraphs: When Suvam S. Mishra began his job search, he was looking for more than just an opportunity—he wanted a platform that could help him showcase his technical skills, prepare for industry expectations, and connect directly with top hiring employers.
He sought structured guidance to elevate his profile and gain direct exposure to leading companies, leading him to join HireKarma's Shortlisted program ecosystem.

columns.title: Preparation & Shortlisted Ecosystem
paragraphs: Through HireKarma's Shortlisted program, Suvam gained access to a structured placement ecosystem designed to bridge the gap between talent and opportunity.

He completed comprehensive skill assessments to validate his technical capabilities, strengthened his interview readiness through structured feedback, and participated in active recruitment drives facilitated through the platform. The personalized guidance and streamlined hiring process enabled him to confidently present his technical capabilities to recruiters.

columns.title: Placement & Impact
paragraphs: His dedication, combined with the support of the Shortlisted program, led to a successful placement as an AI Engineer at Authority Entrepreneurs.

Suvam's story reflects the mission of HireKarma—to empower talented individuals with the right preparation, industry exposure, and employment opportunities. Every successful placement is a testament to the impact of connecting skilled candidates with organizations that value their potential.

details.quote: The Shortlisted program gave me the confidence and direction I needed during my placement journey. From preparing for interviews to connecting with the right employer, every step was well organized and focused on helping candidates succeed. I'm grateful to HireKarma for helping me begin my professional career as an AI Engineer at Authority Entrepreneurs.
